trust_decision.summary: Whether an inbound POST to /webhooks/nextcloud may queue a vector-sync task is decided by comparing the Authorization header to 'Bearer <WEBHOOK_SECRET>' inside handle_nextcloud_webhook; when WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset (the default) no decision is made at all and the attacker-supplied payload user.uid/doc_id flow straight to Qdrant release_document_for_user.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names POST /webhooks/nextcloud, and this handler is the only place the route's auth is enforced; an engineer reads the `if secret: ... else: _warn_missing_secret_once()` branch and sees the fail-open default immediately.

fix_sites.entry_point: app factory route mounting (get_app), reached by POST /webhooks/nextcloud
settings load of WEBHOOK_SECRET via get_settings() (comment-only source change)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: WebhooksClient.create_webhook defaults auth_method="none", but it is a thin OCS transport wrapper in client/ (a different package from the receiver); both known callers pass auth_method explicitly and webhook_auth_pair() now raises before either call, so a solver can argue the unsafe default is the caller's business and leave it alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Polling-only deployments must keep starting and syncing with WEBHOOK_SECRET unset (docs/ADR-010 still promises 'webhooks are purely additive'); an over-broad fix that makes the secret a required/validated setting or makes the app refuse to boot without it breaks the shipped default stack, which runs semantic search with no WEBHOOK_SECRET at all.

O6_input_shapes: Authorization header absent entirely (401 when a secret is set; 503 from the handler when it is not)
Authorization present but wrong secret, or a non-bearer scheme such as 'Basic ...' (401)
Route not mounted at all (404 from the router) versus handler reached with no secret (503) - two distinct shapes of 'webhooks disabled'
Config shape: WEBHOOK_SECRET unset/None (dynaconf default) versus empty string versus set
Registration shapes: multi-event preset (all-or-nothing, zero webhooks may be created) and single JSON body {event, uri, eventFilter|event_filter}

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A CLI/script registration path (cli.py exposes run/worker/db only) calling create_webhook without auth_method, silently registering authMethod='none'.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The Nextcloud API accepts authMethod='none' and the client keeps that as its default, so a maintainer adding a 'nextcloud-mcp-server webhooks register' command or a provisioning hook would plausibly not thread the secret.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second receiver route (e.g. /webhooks/<app>) or a new event family reusing extract_document_task and the same task_producer, repeating the secret gate.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: webhook_parser.py:9-10 states calendar and Tables parsers are planned follow-ups, and each new ingress must re-derive the same WEBHOOK_SECRET decision.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A management endpoint that queues an index/delete for a caller-supplied user_id (e.g. 'reindex user') straight onto app.state.task_producer.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The authenticated management API already has per-user routes (/api/v1/users/{user_id}/revoke, /app-password) and app.state.task_producer is deliberately reachable from route handlers, so a maintainer would reuse it.

O9_family: missing authentication for a critical function (CWE-306) - fail-open webhook receiver

O10_build.toolchain: uv (uv_build backend), pytest + anyio (anyio_mode=auto, pytest-asyncio disabled), pytest-timeout, ruff; `uv sync` then `pytest -m unit`
O10_build.project_tests: tests/unit/test_webhook_endpoint.py (TestClient over a bare Starlette app + anyio memory stream), tests/unit/test_webhook_uri.py, tests/unit/test_webhook_routes_register.py, tests/unit/test_webhooks_api_auth.py, tests/unit/test_management_status_endpoint.py, tests/client/test_webhooks_client.py; integration/contract suites require docker-compose services.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an unconditional bearer check inside handle_nextcloud_webhook() only (or make WEBHOOK_SECRET a required startup setting), leaving the mount gate, both registration call sites and the status field untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: docker-compose.yml at the pinned commit enables semantic search on three services without WEBHOOK_SECRET (lines 101, 162, 307), which is why the default shipped stack exposes the receiver unauthenticated - in scope, recorded as evidence rather than a separate finding.
